bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test -d "$P" || exit 31
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 32
test -z "$(git -C "$P" status --porcelain -- scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py scripts/userbot_topic_entry_audit.py scripts/test_userbot_topic_entry_audit.py)" || exit 33
git -C "$P" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/fix/userbot-topic-entry-audit-20261113
test "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = a94846606cd05b035fe95dd9ee2d8be621f43257 || exit 34
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
chmod 700 "$TMP"
for f in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py userbot_topic_entry_audit.py test_userbot_topic_entry_audit.py; do
  if test -e "$P/scripts/$f"; then cp -p "$P/scripts/$f" "$TMP/old_$f"; fi
  git -C "$P" show "FETCH_HEAD:scripts/$f" > "$TMP/$f"
done
PYTHONPATH="$TMP:$P/scripts" python3 -B -m unittest discover -s "$TMP" -p 'test_userbot_topic_entry_audit.py' -q || exit 35
for f in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py userbot_topic_entry_audit.py test_userbot_topic_entry_audit.py; do install -m 644 "$TMP/$f" "$P/scripts/$f"; done
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
if ! systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || ! python3 -B "$P/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null; then
  for f in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py userbot_topic_entry_audit.py test_userbot_topic_entry_audit.py; do if test -e "$TMP/old_$f"; then cp -p "$TMP/old_$f" "$P/scripts/$f"; else rm -f "$P/scripts/$f"; fi; done
  systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || true
  exit 36
fi
python3 -B "$P/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" topic_entry_audit --chat-id -1003847210571 --page 0 >/dev/null || exit 37
python3 -B "$P/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" topic_entry_audit --chat-id -1003770334893 --page 0 >/dev/null || exit 38
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 39
echo USERBOT_FIRST_AREA_CATEGORY_PAGE_AUDIT_PASS
